trust_rule: Only non-empty exact DER anchors already admitted by the M3 pin, provenance, CA-role, and self-signature gates are supplied to a per-check upstream CertVerifier as local EnterpriseCert roots; no anchor is imported into NSS or profile/global trust.
verification_rule: The alternate path forwards the same peer certificate, time, pin argument, hostname, flags, intermediates, stapled OCSP, SCT, delegated credential, OriginAttributes, output parameters, and immutable upstream OCSP, CT, short-lifetime, and CRLite settings to the unchanged upstream VerifySSLServerCert implementation.
standard_error_rule: Any alternate failure retains the original standard TLS result and an unusable channel through the M4-03 scope seam.
follow_up_boundary: GB100-M4-05 may optimize verifier caching/lifetime without changing this exact-anchor or upstream-validation contract. Production Russian root bytes remain outside this patch and test fixture tree.
